tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id: full description, links, GitHub repository and stars, whether its link responded when last checked, and every reaction with its source, title, number, date, and original discussion URL.

tools.name: similar_products
tools.description: List up to 5 products whose descriptions are closest to the given product's description. Similarity is by description embedding only — not quality, popularity, or recency.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product · Public sink: trending_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product · Public sink: trending_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
